تعتطفين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَطِفِينَ (taʕtaṭifīna) /taʕ.ta.tˤi.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# تُعْتَطَفِينَ (tuʕtaṭafīna) /tuʕ.ta.tˤa.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
